name: pitwall
description: Pit wall style F1 dashboard: live timing and race replays with a live track map.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c auto "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && cd web && npx tsc -b
